name: kyurations
description: Kyurations is a bookmark manager and read-later library. Use it in ChatGPT to search, save and organize the links, notes and lists you keep.

interface.longDescription:
Kyurations is a bookmark manager and read-later library for the things you find online and want to keep: articles, YouTube videos, X and LinkedIn posts, Instagram reels, GitHub repositories, PDFs and your own notes. Each save gets a title, a short summary and tags, and lives in lists you can keep private or publish.

The Kyurations plugin brings that library into ChatGPT, so you can use what you saved without leaving the conversation.

What you can do
- Search your saves by meaning, not only by title. Ask "what did I save about pricing pages?" and get the matching items with their links.
- Filter by platform, author, date or list, and see counts of your library by platform, type, tag or month.
- Save a link or a note from the chat. Kyurations reads the page and fills in the title, summary and tags.
- Organize: create and rename lists, add or remove items, tag, edit, delete and restore items.
- Share: publish a list to get a public link, or make it private again.

Try asking
- "Find what I saved about product onboarding and summarize the main ideas."
- "Save this article to my Reading list."
- "Make a list of my design saves and give me the public link."

Who it is for
Researchers, writers, designers, students, founders and anyone who saves more than they read and wants their bookmarks to be useful.

Privacy and limits
The plugin only reads and changes the library of the Kyurations account you connect, after you sign in and approve access. It never receives your chat history, cannot see other people's private lists, does not browse the web on its own, and cannot buy anything. Deleted items go to the trash and can be restored, and actions that delete or overwrite are marked so ChatGPT asks you first. You can disconnect ChatGPT at any time from Kyurations Settings.

You need a Kyurations account to connect. You can create one at kyurations.in.
capabilities: Search saved bookmarks by topic or meaning
Save links and notes from the chat
Tag, edit, delete and restore saved items
defaultPrompt: Find what I saved about product design
Which of my reading lists have the most items?
Save this link to my library: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bauhaus

positive.description: Find saved items by topic. The demo account holds three typography items in its Typography list.
positive.prompt: What have I saved in Kyurations about typography?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the saved typography items (Practical Typography, the Wikipedia article on typography, and the Nielsen Norman Group article on F-shaped reading) with their titles and links. Does not invent items that are not in the library.

positive.description: Overview of the user's lists and their sizes.
positive.prompt: Which lists do I have in Kyurations, and how many items are in each?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the demo account's lists (Typography, Coffee brewing, Rome trip) with the number of items in each, matching the library.

positive.description: Save a new link into the library.
positive.prompt: Save https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bauhaus to my Kyurations library.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the page and confirms it with its title (Bauhaus) and link. Saving the same link again reports it is already saved rather than creating a duplicate.

positive.description: Create a list and fill it with existing saves found by search.
positive.prompt: Make a new Kyurations list called Weekend reading and add my coffee saves to it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the coffee items, creates a list named Weekend reading, adds them, and reports how many items the new list holds.

positive.description: Save a written note with a tag.
positive.prompt: Save a note in Kyurations: try a 1:16 coffee to water ratio for the V60 tomorrow. Tag it coffee.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the note with the coffee tag and confirms it was saved. The note then appears when searching the library for coffee.

negative.description: Request outside the library: Kyurations cannot book or buy anything.
negative.prompt: Book me a table for two at a restaurant in Trastevere tonight.

negative.description: Another person's private data is not reachable: the plugin only acts on the connected account's own library.
negative.prompt: Show me the private lists my friend saved on Kyurations.

negative.description: A general knowledge question that is not about the user's saved library should be answered without calling Kyurations tools.
negative.prompt: What's the weather going to be like in Rome this weekend?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: search, save, organize and publish your Kyurations library from ChatGPT.
